# MarketForge Launch Plan

Apply across many V3 sections — PR, organic social, paid, lifecycle, founder content.

## Global quality rules

- Launch is not a moment; it's a 6-week sequence (pre-launch + launch week + post-launch).
- Product Hunt + Hacker News + Indie Hackers each have specific norms.
- Pre-launch waitlist for hardware DTC (Pebble model).
- Email list amplifies everything — build before launching.

## Purpose

Build a 6-week launch sequence with specific actions per day per channel.

## Inputs
- All foundation + strategy + brand + website + paid + content decisions.

## Outputs
- `docs/marketing-plan/11-execution/launch-plan.md`
- DEC-750 to DEC-769

## Structure

```markdown
# Launch Plan

## Launch type
- Greenfield product launch.
- Major feature launch.
- New ICP / segment launch.
- Brand relaunch / repositioning.

## Pre-launch (Weeks -6 to -1)

### Week -6
- Finalize positioning + messaging.
- Build pre-launch landing page (waitlist signup).
- Begin founder content series (build audience).
- Begin podcast guesting (4-6 guestings booked through launch week).
- PR pitch list assembled (50-100 outlets / podcasts / newsletters).

### Week -5
- Begin email list outreach (existing customers + waitlist).
- Pre-record founder explainer video.
- Schedule influencer / customer pre-access.

### Week -4
- Press embargo (if applicable) — 2-3 outlets confirmed.
- Pre-launch teaser social posts (founder).
- Direct outreach to top 50 "warm" supporters for launch-day amplification.

### Week -3
- Influencer / creator seeding (DTC / consumer).
- Beta customer early access if applicable.
- Finalize all launch-day assets.

### Week -2
- Launch-day rehearsal: trial run of Product Hunt submission, social sequence, email send.
- Confirm all launch-day publishing schedule.
- Finalize Q&A for launch-day comments / DMs.

### Week -1
- Final asset review.
- Schedule launch-day posts.
- Brief the team on launch-day responsibilities.

## Launch day (Week 0)

### Hour 0 (00:01 PST or relevant launch timezone)
- Product Hunt submission goes live.
- HackerNews submission (if technical product).
- Indie Hackers / Reddit (relevant subs, follow promo rules).

### Hour +2
- Founder LinkedIn launch post.
- Founder X thread.
- Email blast to waitlist / list.

### Hour +4
- Customer + supporter amplification (DMs go out for promised support).
- Founder is full-day in launch responses.

### Hour +8
- PR placements go live (if embargo).
- Mid-day social check-ins (founder visible).

### Hour +12
- Evening recap post on social.
- DMs to top engagers.

## Post-launch (Weeks +1 to +5)

### Week +1
- Recap content (long-form blog "how launch went").
- Continued PR pitches with launch as hook.
- Paid ads turned on (if pre-confirmed channel).
- Lifecycle email Welcome flow tuning based on launch-cohort behavior.

### Weeks +2 to +5
- Continued amplification across organic channels.
- Cold outreach using launch as conversation-opener.
- Optimization of paid spend based on launch-cohort performance.
- Press follow-up (some outlets publish 2-4 weeks after launch).

## Platform-specific tactics

### Product Hunt
- Hunter selection (or self-hunt).
- Schedule: 00:01 PT for max 24-hour exposure.
- Comments-first response strategy.
- Cross-promote with other launches that day.

### Hacker News
- "Show HN: [Project]" format.
- Founder responds to every comment (HN expects this).
- Don't over-promote.
- Substantive Q&A.

### Indie Hackers
- Launch post in Maker community.
- Genuine engagement, not promo-only.

### AppSumo (when product fits)
- DTC SaaS deal: requires acceptance.
- Lifetime-deal pricing.

### Press / PR
- Tier 1 outlets: 2-3 confirmed before launch (warm intro essential).
- Tier 2: 5-10 industry pubs.
- Tier 3: 20-30 newsletters / podcasts.

### Email list
- Pre-launch teaser (2 weeks before).
- Launch day announcement.
- Post-launch follow-up.

## Coordination with paid + lifecycle

- Paid ads queued but optionally not live until launch day (some prefer pre-launch for waitlist).
- Lifecycle Welcome flow ready for launch traffic.
- Onboarding A/B test deferred until post-launch stabilization.

## Decision cards
[DEC-750 to DEC-769]

## Anti-patterns

- Launch day with no audience built (no email list, no waitlist).
- Multiple platforms on launch day without team capacity.
- Reading from script in founder content (kills authenticity).
- Burning email list with sustained promo without value.
- Buying upvotes / engagement on launch platforms.

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- Buying placements.
- Astroturfing.
- Inviting team to "engage" without genuine support.
- Launching without pre-built audience.

## Sources and basis
V3 various.
```
